047/**
048 * This class manages a list of {@link ListItem}.
049 * See {@link GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo} for GlazedList specific handling.
050 * The ListItem elements are {@literal {key, displayValue, <D2>}};
051 * where key is generally a primary key, displayValue has display info,
052 * {@code <D2>} has additional data. {@code <D2>} is optional, see
053 * {@link #setD2Enabled(boolean)} and the constructors. There are ways
054 * to create, modify and examine the ListItem. Individual read-only lists for
055 * keys, displayValues, {@code <D2>} are available, for example {@link #getKeys() }.
056 * {@code <D>} is conventionally known as the displayValue and {@code <D2>}
057 * is optional data.
058 * {@link ListItemFormat} creates a String to display a list item using any
059 * or all of the list item elements.
060 * <p>
061 * Use {@link #getRemodel} for modifying and examining the itemList and list items.
062 * Depending on how it's set up, {@code getRemodel} may give multi-thread safe
063 * access. When the list is used by Glazed remodel lock uses the EventList lock.
064 * When there's no locking, using Remodel is performant.
065 *
066 * @param <K> key type; key is typically primary key
067 * @param <D> displayValue type; displayValue provides display string
068 * @param <D2>  {@code <D2>} type; if present, supplementary data
069 *
070 * @see AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel
071 * AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel for general description of using this class
072 * @see <a href="https://javadoc.io/doc/com.glazedlists/glazedlists/latest/ca/odell/glazedlists/swing/AutoCompleteSupport.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GlazedLists AutoCompletion javadoc</a>
073 *
074 * @since 4.0.0
075 */
076public class KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K, D, D2> extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel {
077  /** index of displayValue in ListItem */
078  // DisplayValue IS FIRST. THIS IS THE DEFAULT FOR ListItemFormat
079  // In addition, only DisplayValue is required.
080  // LOOK AT createDisplayValueItem BEFORE THINKING ABOUT CHANGING THESE DEFINES
081  protected final static int DISP_IDX = 0; //
082  /** index of primary key in ListItem */
083  protected final static int KEY_IDX = 1;
084  /** index of d2 in ListItem */
085  protected final static int DISP2_IDX = 2;
086
087  /** up to 3 slices created, DISP, KEY, DISP2 */
088  private final List<?>[] slices = new List<?>[3];
089  /** when true, there can be displayValues2 */
090  private boolean d2Enabled = false;
091
092  /**
093   * Given some tModel, if possible return the tModel cast as a KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.
094   * @param model tModel to check
095   * @return KeyDisplayValueSwingModel or null
096   */
097  public static KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<?, ?, ?> asKeyDisplayValueSwingModel(
098      ListModel<ListItem> model) {
099    if (model instanceof KeyDisplayValueSwingModel) {
100                        return (KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<?,?,?>) model;
101    }
102    if (model instanceof ComboBoxListSwingModel comboBoxListSwingModel) {
103      Object tModel = comboBoxListSwingModel.getComboBoxListSwingModel();
104      if (tModel instanceof KeyDisplayValueSwingModel) {
105                                return (KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<?,?,?>) tModel;
106      }
107    }
108    return null;
109  }
110
111  /** Use with constructors to specify D2 or not */
112  public enum HasD2 {
113    /** With D2: key, displayValue, D2. */
114    TRUE,
115    /** No D2: key, displayValue. */
116    FALSE;
117  }

120   * Create an empty KeyDisplayValueSwingModel with no {@code <D2>}.

135  /**
136   * Create an empty KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.
137   * @param d2Flag true says to provide a d2 field in ListItem
138   * @param itemList tModel backing store
139   */
140  public KeyDisplayValueSwingModel(HasD2 d2Flag, List<ListItem> itemList) {
141    super(d2Flag == HasD2.TRUE ? 3 : 2, itemList);
142    this.d2Enabled = d2Flag == HasD2.TRUE;
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * create List slices lazily
147   * @param sliceIndex elem index in ListItem
148   * @return the slice for the specified elem
149   */
150  private <T> List<T> getSlice(int sliceIndex) {
151    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
152    List<T> slice = (List<T>) slices[sliceIndex];
153    if (slice == null) {
154      slice = createElementSlice(sliceIndex);
155      slices[sliceIndex] = slice;
156    }
157
158    return slice;
159  }

162   * Note when getAllowNull is true, the first list item is null/""
163   * @return unmodifiable list of keys
164   */
165  public List<K> getKeys() {
166    return getSlice(KEY_IDX);
167  }

181  public List<D2> getD2() {
182    return getSlice(DISP2_IDX);
183  }

185  /**
186   * Change whether the layout of an ListItem managed by this class
187   * contains a displayValue. An exception is thrown if the item list
188   * is not empty. An existing d2 list {@link #getD2}
189   * is invalidated or validated accordingly.
190   * @param d2Enbl true if list item shall contain displayValue
191   */
192  public void setD2Enabled(boolean d2Enbl) {
193    if (!getItemList().isEmpty()) {
194      throw new IllegalStateException("Only change displaValue2enabled when empty");
195    }
196    if (d2Enabled == d2Enbl) {
197      return;
198    }
199    d2Enabled = d2Enbl;
200    // normally 2 elements in ListItem {key,displaValue}, displaValue2 add 3rd.
201    setItemNumElems(d2Enbl ? 3 : 2);
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * convenient verification that displaValue2 is enabled
206   */
207  private void usingD2() {
208    if (!d2Enabled) {
209      throw new IllegalStateException("d2enabled is false");
210    }
211  }
212
213  /**
214   * Consistency checks can be placed in here. It is called
215   * from every method in remodel. Keep it cheap for production code.
216   */
217  @Override
218  protected void checkState() {
219    // consistency check can be placed here
220  }

222  /**
223   * Create a list item with the specified contents.
224   * @param key value (primary key)
225   * @param displayValue display info derived from this
226   * @param d2 additional display info
227   * @return the new list item
228   */
229  protected ListItem createDisplayValueItem(K key, D displayValue, D2 d2) {
230    // ALL ListItem CREATION GOES THROUGH HERE
231    // THE DEFINES FOR KEY_IDX, DISP_IDX ARE RELEVANT TO THE ORDER.
232    // displayValue MUST GO FIRST
233    return d2Enabled ? createListItem(displayValue, key, d2) : createListItem(displayValue, key);
234  }
235
236  /**
237   * Create a list of list items with the specified contents;
238   * the lists must be the same size.
239   * @param keys list of key values (primary key)
240   * @param displayValues display info derived from this
241   * @param d2 additional display info
242   * @return the new list item
243   */
244  protected List<ListItem> createDisplayValueItems(List<K> keys, List<D> displayValues,
245                                                     List<D2> d2) {
246    Objects.requireNonNull(keys);
247    Objects.requireNonNull(displayValues);
248    if (d2Enabled) {
249      Objects.requireNonNull(d2);
250    } else {
251      if (d2 != null) {
252        throw new IllegalArgumentException("displayValues2 provided, but not enabled");
253      }
254    }
255    int n = keys.size();
256    if (displayValues.size() != n || d2 != null && d2.size() != n) {
257      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Lists must be the same size");
258    }
259    List<ListItem> displayValueItems = new ArrayList<>(keys.size());
260    if (d2Enabled && d2 != null) {
261      for (int i = 0; i < keys.size(); i++) {
262        displayValueItems.add(createDisplayValueItem(keys.get(i), displayValues.get(i), d2.get(i)));
263      }
264    } else {
265      for (int i = 0; i < keys.size(); i++) {
266        displayValueItems.add(createDisplayValueItem(keys.get(i), displayValues.get(i), null));
267      }
268    }
269    return displayValueItems;
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * @return true if a list item contains displaValue2
274   */
275  public boolean isD2Enabled() {
276    return d2Enabled;
277  }

306  /**
307   * Get a remodel object to make changes. This does no locking
308   * and there's only one remodel which is reused, so there's
309   * special handling required.
310   * @return Remodel
311   * @see Remodel
312   */
313  // TODO: 
314  @Override
315  public Remodel getRemodel() {
316    // default is no locking, re-use the tModel.
317    if (remodel == null) {
318      reuse = true; // Flag that we're doing reuse.
319      // Do a lock then unlock to get the shared remodel into a known state.
320      remodel = new Remodel();
321    } else
322      remodelTakeWriteLock(remodel);
323    return remodel;
324  }
325  private boolean reuse;
326  private Remodel remodel;
327
328  /**
329   * Since we're resusing the remodel a single Remodel, we need to keep
330   * it open as long as there's some open locks.
331   * We don't have a lock, pass the take/release on for counting.
332   */
333  @Override
334  protected void remodelTakeWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
335    if (reuse) {
336      if(checkLocksHeld() == 0 && !remodel.isClosed)
337        throw new IllegalStateException("No locks and not closed");
338    }
339    super.remodelTakeWriteLock(remodel);
340  }
341  /**
342   * Since we're resusing the remodel a single Remodel, we need to keep
343   * it open as long as there's some open locks.
344   * We don't have a lock, so pass the take/release on for counting.
345   */
346  @Override
347  protected void remodelReleaseWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
348    super.remodelReleaseWriteLock(remodel);
349    // Since this class' remodel is reused, keep it open as long as there's
350    // a lock. There is no real lock, so OK to check after releasing lock.
351    if (reuse) {
352      if (checkLocksHeld() != 0)
353        remodel.isClosed = false;
354    }
355  }

357  /**
358   * Add some additional methods for inspecting and modifying list info
359   * with key/displayValue/D2.
360   * See {@link AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel}
361   * <p>
362   * This pattern should be used when working with the list to guarantee
363   * exclusive access. It avoids many potential synchronization problems.
364   * Nesting is OK.
365   * {@snippet lang="java" :
366   *     try (Model.remodel remodel = keyVis.getRemodel()) {
367   *         // ...
368   *     }
369   * }
370   * When there is no locking, getRemodel() is fast; there is minimal overhead.
371   */
372  public class Remodel extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel {
373    /**
374     * Return an unmodifiable list of keys.
375     * <p>
376     * <b>When getAllowNull() is true, the first list item is null/""</b>
377     * @return list of keys
378     */
379    public List<K> getKeys() {
380      verifyOpened();
381      return KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.this.getKeys();
382    }
383
384    /**
385     * Return an unmodifiable list of displayValue.
386     * <p>
387     * <b>When getAllowNull() is true, the first list item is null/""</b>
388     * @return list of displayValue
389     */
390    public List<D> getDisplayValues() {
391      verifyOpened();
392      return KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.this.getDisplayValues();
393    }
394
395    /**
396     * Return an unmodifiable list of displaValue2.
397     * <p>
398     * <b>When getAllowNull() is true, the first list item is null/""</b>
399     * @return list of d2
400     */
401    public List<D2> getD2() {
402      verifyOpened();
403      return KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.this.getD2();
404    }
405
406    /**
407     * Extract the key from the list item.
408     * @param listItem list item from which key is extracted
409     * @return the key
410     */
411    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
412    public K getKey(ListItem listItem) {
413      return (K) super.getElem(listItem, KEY_IDX);
414    }
415
416    /**
417     * Extract the displayValue from the list item.
418     * @param listItem list item from which displayValue is extracted
419     * @return the displayValue
420     */
421    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
422    public D getDisplayValue(ListItem listItem) {
423      return (D) super.getElem(listItem, DISP_IDX);
424    }
425
426    /**
427     * Extract the displayValue from the list item.
428     * @param listItem list item from which displayValue is extracted
429     * @return the displayValue
430     */
431    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
432    public D2 getD2(ListItem listItem) {
433      usingD2();
434      return (D2) super.getElem(listItem, DISP2_IDX);
435    }
436
437    /**
438     * Extract the key from the list item at the specified item list index.
439     * Convenience method for {@code getKey(getEventList().get(index))}
440     * @param index an item list index
441     * @return the displayValue
442     */
443    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
444    public K getKey(int index) {
445      return (K) super.getElem(index, KEY_IDX);
446    }
447
448    /**
449     * Set the key element of the list item
450     * at the specified item list index.
451     * @param index of list item
452     * @param key put this into list item
453     * @return previous contents; the replaced element.
454     */
455    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
456    public D setKey(int index, D key) {
457      return (D) super.setElem(index, DISP_IDX, key);
458    }
459
460    /**
461     * Set the displayValue element of the list item
462     * at the specified item list index.
463     * @param index of list item
464     * @param displayValue put this into list item
465     * @return previous contents; the replaced element.
466     */
467    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
468    public D setDisplayValue(int index, D displayValue) {
469      return (D) super.setElem(index, DISP_IDX, displayValue);
470    }
471
472    /**
473     * Set the displayValue element of the list item
474     * at the specified item list index.
475     * @param index of list item
476     * @param d2 put this into list item
477     * @return previous contents; the replaced element
478     */
479    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
480    public D2 setD2(int index, D2 d2) {
481      usingD2();
482      return (D2) super.setElem(index, DISP2_IDX, d2);
483    }
484
485    /**
486     * Add list items with the specified contents. The input lists shall be the same size.
487     * @param keys list of key values (primary keys)
488     * @param displayValues list of display info
489     * @return the new list item
490     */
491    public boolean addAll(List<K> keys, List<D> displayValues) {
492      return addAll(keys, displayValues, null);
493    }
494
495    /**
496     * Add list items with the specified contents. The input lists shall be the same size.
497     * @param keys list of values (often a primary key)
498     * @param displayValues display info derived from this
499     * @param d2s additional display info
500     * @return true if the list changed
501     */
502    public boolean addAll(List<K> keys, List<D> displayValues, List<D2> d2s) {
503      if (d2s != null) {
504        usingD2();
505      }
506      List<ListItem> list
507          = KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.this.createDisplayValueItems(keys, displayValues, d2s);
508      return super.addAll(list);
509      //isModifiedLength = true;
510    }
511

513     * Create an ListItem with the specified contents
514     * and add it to the item list. The input lists shall be the same size.

517     * @return the new list item
518     */
519    public boolean add(K key, D displayValue) {
520      return add(key, displayValue, null);
521    }
522
523    /**
524     * Create an ListItem with the specified contents
525     * and add it to the item list. The input lists shall be the same size.
526     * @param key commonly a primary key
527     * @param displayValue display info derived from this
528     * @param d2 additional display info

531    public boolean add(K key, D displayValue, D2 d2) {

533        usingD2();
534      }

536      //itemList.add(createDisplayValueItem(key, displayValue, d2));
537      //isModifiedLength = true;
538      //return true;
539    }
540
541    /**
542     * Create a list item with the specified contents.
543     * @param key key value (primary key)
544     * @param displayValue display info derived from this
545     * @param d2 additional display info
546     * @return the new list item
547     */
548    public ListItem createKeyDisplayValueItem(K key, D displayValue, D2 d2) {
549      return KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.this.createDisplayValueItem(key, displayValue, d2);
550    }
551  }
